name: Citrus Sunrise Highball
steps: Stir orange and lime juice over ice
Drizzle grenadine down the glass wall so it sinks
Serve unstirred for the sunrise gradient

name: Electric Blue Lagoon Sparkler
steps: Add blue syrup and lemon to an iced glass
Top with lemon-lime soda
Stir once, gently

name: Sparkling Berry Sangria Punch
steps: Drop diced fruit into an iced glass
Pour in grape and orange juice
Top with sparkling cider right before serving

name: Passionfruit Mint Sparkler
steps: Shake passionfruit, lime and agave with ice
Strain over fresh ice
Top with soda; slap a mint sprig to wake the oils

name: Pomegranate Rose Spritz
steps: Combine pomegranate, rose water and lemon
Add ice and top slowly with tonic
Scatter pomegranate seeds

name: Tart Cherry Limeade Fizz
steps: Stir cherry, lime and syrup at the base
Fill with cubed ice
Top with soda

name: Grapefruit Rosemary Spritz
steps: Shake grapefruit, rosemary syrup and lemon with ice
Strain over fresh ice
Top with soda; torch a rosemary sprig

name: Zero-Proof Paloma
steps: Rim the glass with lime and coarse salt
Stir grapefruit, lime and agave
Add ice, top with sparkling water

name: Shirley Temple
steps: Fill glass with ice and ginger ale
Pour grenadine in last so it sinks
Add a squeeze of lime

name: Roy Rogers
steps: Fill glass with ice and cola
Drizzle grenadine to sink

name: Sparkling Cranberry Mocktail
steps: Pour cranberry and lime over ice
Top with sparkling cider
Garnish with rosemary

name: Sparkling Pomegranate Mocktail
steps: Add pomegranate juice and lemon to a chilled flute
Top with sparkling water

name: Mimosa Mocktail
steps: Pour chilled orange juice into a flute
Top gently with sparkling cider or white grape

name: Rose Mocktail
steps: Add rose syrup to an iced glass
Top with lemon-lime soda and stir

name: Rose & Rhubarb Soda
steps: Stir rhubarb (or strawberry) syrup with rose water and lemon
Add ice and top with soda

name: Beet-Sumac Soda
steps: Stir beet juice, syrup and lemon
Add ice and top with soda water

name: Homemade Tarragon Soda
steps: Steep fresh tarragon (or basil) in warm syrup and cool
Pour over ice with lemon
Top with soda

name: Cider, Thyme & Tonic
steps: Lightly bruise thyme in the glass
Add ice and apple cider
Top with tonic

name: Ranch Water (Zero-Proof)
steps: Add lime and a pinch of salt over ice
Top with very bubbly mineral water

name: Italian Greyhound Spritz
steps: Build grapefruit and orange over ice in a wine glass
Top with tonic for the bitter edge

name: Sparkling Citrus Hibiscus Cooler
steps: Dissolve honey into orange juice at the base with ice
Layer cold hibiscus tea over a spoon
Top with soda for a ruby-to-orange fade

name: Cucumber Mint Hydration Refresher
steps: Muddle cucumber, mint, lime, syrup and salt
Pack with ice
Top with soda

name: Lavender Honey Lemonade
steps: Mix lavender syrup, lemon and honey
Add ice and cold water
Stir well

name: Thyme Blackberry Breeze
steps: Muddle blackberries and thyme
Shake with lemon, syrup and ice
Double strain and top with sparkling cider

name: Basil Watermelon Smash
steps: Muddle watermelon, basil, lime and agave
Fill with crushed ice
Top with ginger ale

name: Elderflower Apple Sparkler
steps: Stir elderflower, apple and lemon with ice
Strain into a chilled glass
Top with sparkling water

name: Chamomile Peach Mule
steps: Fill a mug with ice
Add chamomile, peach and lemon and stir
Top with ginger beer

name: Minted Green Tea Sparkler
steps: Mix green tea, lemongrass syrup and lime over ice
Top with sparkling water

name: Sage Grapefruit Tonic
steps: Bruise sage in the shaker
Shake briefly with grapefruit, honey and ice
Strain over ice and top with tonic

name: Hibiscus Lemongrass Basil Iced Tea
steps: Steep hibiscus with lemongrass and cool
Stir in lime and honey
Pour over ice with torn basil

name: Tangerine Rosemary Mocktail
steps: Shake tangerine juice with rosemary syrup and ice
Strain over ice and top with soda

name: Cranberry Rosemary Refresher
steps: Stir cranberry, rosemary syrup and lime over ice
Top with soda

name: Watermelon Mint Cider-Vinegar Tonic
steps: Blend or muddle watermelon with mint
Shake with vinegar, honey and ice
Strain and top with soda

name: Pineapple Coconut Water
steps: Stir pineapple and fresh ginger juice
Top with coconut water over ice

name: Strawberry Basil Fields
steps: Muddle strawberries and basil
Add lemon, syrup and ice, then stir
Top with soda

name: Classic Lemonade
steps: Stir lemon and syrup together
Add cold water and ice

name: Pink Strawberry Lemonade
steps: Muddle strawberries with syrup
Add lemon and water over ice

name: Fresh Ginger Lemonade
steps: Grate ginger and steep in warm honey water, then cool
Strain, add lemon and ice

name: Ginger Spiced Lemonade
steps: Simmer ginger with jaggery and a pinch of pepper
Cool, strain, add lemon, water and ice

name: Saffron Cardamom Lemonade
steps: Warm syrup with saffron and crushed cardamom; cool
Stir with lemon, water and ice

name: Arnold Palmer
steps: Half iced tea, half lemonade over ice
Stir

name: Lemon Squeeze
steps: Shake lemon and honey with ice
Strain and top with soda

name: Cherry Limeade
steps: Squeeze lime over ice
Add cherry syrup and top with soda

name: Watermelon Mocktail
steps: Blend watermelon and strain
Stir with lime, mint and salt
Top with soda over ice

name: Virgin Mojito
steps: Lightly press mint with lime and syrup
Pack with crushed ice
Top with soda and lift the mint

name: Cardamom Mojito Mocktail
steps: Crush cardamom pods with mint, lime and syrup
Add crushed ice
Top with soda

name: Pomegranate Mojito Mocktail
steps: Muddle mint with lime and syrup
Add pomegranate juice and ice
Top with soda

name: Virgin Piña Colada
steps: Blend pineapple, coconut cream and lime with a cup of ice
Blend until silky, about 25 seconds

name: Virgin Mary
steps: Roll tomato juice, lemon and seasonings between two glasses
Pour over ice

name: Zero-Proof Margarita
steps: Salt the rim
Shake lime, orange and agave with ice
Strain and add a splash of soda

name: Spicy Mango Margarita (Zero-Proof)
steps: Rim with chili salt
Shake mango, lime, agave and a jalapeño slice with ice
Strain over ice and splash soda

name: Zero-Proof Moscow Mule
steps: Squeeze lime into an iced mug
Top with ginger beer

name: Pom Mexican Mule
steps: Build pomegranate and lime over ice
Top with ginger beer

name: Faux Cosmopolitan
steps: Shake all with ice
Strain into a chilled coupe

name: Virgin Daiquiri (Strawberry)
steps: Blend strawberries, lime and syrup with a cup of ice

name: Non-Alcoholic Appletini
steps: Shake green apple juice, lemon and syrup hard with ice
Strain into a chilled martini glass

name: Watermelon Punch (Zero-Proof)
steps: Blend and strain watermelon
Stir with lime, mint and a whisper of warm spice
Top with soda over ice

name: Pineapple Punch
steps: Stir juices and grenadine over ice
Top with ginger ale

name: 5-Minute Mango Mocktail
steps: Stir mango pulp with lime and mint
Top with lemon-lime soda over ice

name: Penicillin Mocktail
steps: Shake lemon, honey-ginger syrup and smoky lapsang tea with ice
Strain over a big cube

name: Coconut Strawberry Cream Bliss
steps: Purée strawberries into the glass base with crushed ice
Shake coconut milk and vanilla until frothy
Pour gently over the red layer

name: Creamy Banana Chai Frappe
steps: Blend frozen banana, chai and milk until thick
Dust with cinnamon

name: Avocado Lime Frost
steps: Blend avocado, lime, sweetener and coconut water with ice until velvety

name: Frozen Peach Velvet Slush
steps: Blend frozen peaches, grape juice, lemon and honey
Pour the thick slush into a chilled glass

name: Guava Cream Dream
steps: Shake guava, coconut cream, lime and syrup hard with ice
Strain over fresh ice

name: Watermelon Lime Mint Chiller
steps: Blend watermelon, lime, agave and mint with ice until slushy

name: Peanut Butter Banana Coffee Smoothie
steps: Blend frozen banana, chilled coffee, milk, peanut butter and vanilla until smooth

name: Energizing Green Smoothie
steps: Blend greens with banana, pineapple and coconut water until smooth

name: Tropical Fruit Smoothie
steps: Blend all with a handful of ice

name: Blueberry Cashew Buckwheat Smoothie
steps: Blend soaked cashews, blueberries, banana and milk until creamy

name: Berry Banana Protein Shake
steps: Blend everything until smooth and thick

name: Strawberry Milkshake
steps: Blend strawberries, ice cream and milk until thick

name: Citrus Espresso Tonic
steps: Fill a glass with big ice
Add orange syrup and tonic
Float the cooled espresso slowly on top; express orange peel

name: Iced Vanilla Oat Latte
steps: Stir vanilla into oat milk over ice
Pour espresso slowly for marbling

name: Ginger Cold Brew Fizz
steps: Add ginger beer and lime over ice
Layer cold brew slowly on top

name: Hibiscus Cold Brew Tonic
steps: Combine hibiscus and tonic over ice
Float cold brew on top

name: Salted Caramel Iced Coffee
steps: Stir caramel into cold brew over ice
Top with milk
Finish with flaky salt

name: Spiced Mocha Chiller
steps: Blend coffee, milk, cocoa, maple and a pinch of cayenne with ice
Top with whipped cream and cocoa

name: Cold Brew
steps: Steep coarse grounds in cold water 12-24 h, strain
Dilute over ice

name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee
steps: Brew strong coffee onto condensed milk
Stir and pour over ice

name: Thai Iced Coffee
steps: Mix the two milks and vanilla in the glass
Add ice and pour coffee over

name: Kori-Kohi (Coffee Ice Cubes & Milk)
steps: Freeze sweetened coffee in cube trays
Pour warm or cold milk over the coffee cubes and watch them melt

name: Peanut Butter Iced Coffee
steps: Blend coffee, peanut butter, milk and sweetener
Pour over ice

name: Iced White Chocolate Mocha
steps: Stir white chocolate sauce into cold brew
Add milk and ice

name: Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew
steps: Whisk cream, condensed milk and vanilla
Pour cold brew over ice and float the sweet cream

name: Iced Caramel Macchiato
steps: Vanilla at the bottom, then milk and ice
Pour espresso on top
Lattice caramel over

name: Dirty Horchata
steps: Soak rice, blend with water, strain
Sweeten with honey, cinnamon and vanilla
Add milk, ice and a coffee float

name: Homemade Frappuccino
steps: Blend coffee, milk, sugar and lots of ice
Top with whipped cream

name: Lavender Frappuccino
steps: Blend coffee, milk, lavender syrup and ice

name: Iced Coffee with Ice Cream
steps: Pour chilled coffee and milk over ice
Top with a scoop of ice cream

name: Coconut Milk Iced Coffee
steps: Stir coffee and sweetener over ice
Top with coconut milk

name: Indian Cold Coffee
steps: Whip instant coffee with sugar and a splash of water
Blend with cold milk and ice cream until frothy

name: Iced Pistachio Latte
steps: Blend pistachio with milk and syrup
Pour over ice and float espresso

name: Espresso Martini (Zero-Proof)
steps: Shake hot espresso hard with syrup and ice for a thick crema
Strain into a chilled glass

name: Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng)
steps: Whisk yolks, sugar and condensed milk until pale and thick
Spoon the foam over hot coffee

name: Affogato
steps: Scoop ice cream into a cup
Pour hot espresso over it at the table

name: Mocha Latte
steps: Dissolve coffee and cocoa in hot water
Top with frothed hot milk

name: Dirty Chai Latte
steps: Combine chai and a shot of coffee
Top with frothed milk

name: Mexican Coffee
steps: Brew coffee with cinnamon and a little chocolate
Finish with a splash of milk

name: Café de Olla
steps: Simmer coffee with piloncillo (or jaggery), cinnamon and orange peel
Strain into mugs

name: Café Bombón
steps: Add condensed milk to a small glass
Pour espresso slowly on top to keep two layers

name: Café con Leche
steps: Pour strong coffee
Add an equal-ish pour of hot milk

name: Flat White
steps: Pull a double shot
Pour silky micro-foamed milk

name: Apple Crisp Macchiato
steps: Warm milk with apple syrup and cinnamon
Pour espresso on top
Drizzle with spiced caramel

name: Gingerbread Latte
steps: Stir gingerbread syrup (molasses, ginger, spice) into espresso
Top with steamed milk

name: Peppermint Mocha
steps: Stir chocolate and peppermint into espresso
Top with steamed milk

name: Pistachio Latte (Hot)
steps: Blend pistachio paste into hot milk
Pour over espresso

name: Billionaire's Latte
steps: Stir caramel and chocolate into espresso
Top with steamed milk and shortbread crumbs

name: Eggnog Latte
steps: Gently heat milk, cream, yolk and sugar until thick (no boil)
Pour over espresso, grate nutmeg on top

name: Ruby Chocolate Latte
steps: Melt ruby chocolate into hot milk
Add a short espresso

name: Coconut Milk Coffee (Hot)
steps: Heat and froth coconut milk
Pour over coffee

name: South Indian Filter Coffee
steps: Mix thick decoction with hot milk and sugar
Pour between tumbler and dabara to froth

name: Thai Spiced Iced Tea
steps: Pour sweetened Thai tea over crushed ice
Float evaporated milk on top

name: Earl Grey Fog & Tonic
steps: Stir tea, lemon and honey with ice
Top with tonic

name: Peach Rosemary Iced Tea
steps: Stir tea, peach and rosemary syrup hard with ice

name: Matcha Vanilla Swirl
steps: Whisk matcha with warm water until frothy
Fill glass with ice, milk and vanilla
Pour matcha slowly on top to swirl

name: Matcha Island
steps: Shake matcha with pineapple, coconut, lime and syrup
Strain over ice

name: Masala Chai
steps: Simmer water with crushed ginger and whole spices
Add tea leaves, then milk and sugar
Boil up twice and strain

name: Adrak Chai (Ginger Tea)
steps: Boil grated ginger in water
Add tea, milk and sugar; simmer and strain

name: Elaichi Chai (Cardamom Tea)
steps: Crush cardamom and boil with water
Add tea, milk and sugar; simmer and strain

name: Doodh Patti Chai
steps: Simmer tea leaves directly in milk (little or no water)
Sweeten and strain

name: Karak Chai
steps: Strongly boil tea with cardamom and saffron
Add evaporated milk and sugar; reduce until rich

name: Kesar Chai (Saffron Tea)
steps: Bloom saffron in warm milk
Brew tea with cardamom, add saffron milk, simmer

name: Lemon Ginger Tea
steps: Simmer sliced ginger in water
Off heat, add lemon and honey

name: Iced Chai Latte
steps: Pour chai concentrate over ice
Top with cold milk

name: Chai Blossom Soda
steps: Stir spiced chai syrup with lime over ice
Top with club soda

name: Classic Southern Sweet Tea
steps: Brew strong tea and sweeten while hot
Cool and pour over ice

name: Chamomile Honey Iced Tea
steps: Brew chamomile, sweeten with honey, cool
Pour over ice with lemon

name: Masala Shikanji
steps: Dissolve lemon, syrup, roasted cumin and black salt
Add ice and soda; stir in mint

name: Nimbu Pani
steps: Stir lemon, sugar and a pinch of salt into chilled water

name: Jaljeera
steps: Blend herbs, tamarind, spices and lemon with a little water
Strain into an iced glass and top up with water or soda

name: Jeera Pani Soda
steps: Stir roasted cumin, lemon, salt and a little sugar
Top with soda over ice

name: Masala Soda
steps: Add masala, lemon and sugar to the glass
Top with very fizzy soda and stir quickly

name: Aam Panna
steps: Boil raw mango, scoop the pulp
Blend with jaggery, cumin, salt and mint
Dilute with cold water over ice

name: Kokum Sharbat
steps: Stir kokum syrup with roasted cumin and salt
Top with chilled water

name: Sol Kadhi
steps: Whisk kokum extract into coconut milk
Season with ginger, chili, salt and coriander

name: Rooh Afza Sharbat
steps: Stir rose syrup into chilled water
Add soaked sabja seeds and ice

name: Mango Cardamom Lassi
steps: Blend mango, yogurt, milk, honey and cardamom until frothy
Pour over two ice cubes

name: Sweet Lassi
steps: Whisk chilled yogurt with sugar and a little water until frothy

name: Rose Cardamom Lassi
steps: Blend yogurt with rose syrup and cardamom

name: Salted Mint Lassi
steps: Blend yogurt with mint, cumin and salt

name: Cardamom Banana Lassi
steps: Blend all until smooth

name: Melon Lassi
steps: Blend frozen melon with yogurt and sugar

name: Strawberry Lassi
steps: Blend strawberries, yogurt, sugar and milk

name: Mango Coconut Passionfruit Lassi (Dairy-Free)
steps: Blend mango, coconut yogurt/milk and passionfruit until smooth

name: Kefir Mango Lassi
steps: Blend mango with kefir (or thin yogurt) and honey

name: Masala Chaas
steps: Whisk yogurt thin with water
Season with cumin, salt, ginger and herbs

name: Soda Chaas
steps: Whisk spiced buttermilk
Top with soda just before serving

name: Piyush
steps: Whisk thick sweet yogurt (shrikhand) with milk
Flavour with saffron, cardamom and nutmeg

name: Thandai
steps: Grind soaked nuts, seeds and spices into a paste
Blend with cold milk, sugar and saffron
Strain and chill

name: Mango Thandai
steps: Blend thandai masala with mango pulp and cold milk

name: Mango Mastani
steps: Blend mango and milk into a thick shake
Top with a scoop of ice cream and nuts

name: Rose Falooda
steps: Layer rose syrup, soaked sabja and falooda sev
Pour cold milk
Top with ice cream

name: Badam Milk
steps: Blend soaked almonds into milk
Simmer with saffron, cardamom and sugar
Serve warm or chilled

name: Kesar Milk (Saffron Milk)
steps: Simmer milk with saffron and cardamom
Sweeten and add slivered nuts

name: Masala Doodh
steps: Simmer milk with masala doodh powder (nuts, spices)
Sweeten and serve hot

name: Saffron Cardamom Horchata
steps: Soak rice and almonds; blend with water and strain
Sweeten, add saffron and cardamom, serve over ice

name: Watermelon Juice (Tarbooz)
steps: Blend watermelon and strain
Add lemon, a pinch of salt and mint

name: Fresh Pomegranate Juice
steps: Pulse arils briefly and strain
Add a dash of lemon and salt

name: Fresh Pineapple Juice
steps: Blend pineapple with a little water
Strain and serve cold

name: Mint & Clove Ginger Beer (Homemade)
steps: Simmer ginger and cloves in syrup; cool
Muddle mint with lime
Add syrup and ice, top with soda

name: Fiery Ginger Beer Bug
steps: Stir fresh ginger juice, lime and honey syrup
Add ice and top with sparkling water

name: Spiced Apple Cider Sparkler
steps: Whisk cider, lemon and spices in the glass
Add ice, top with ginger ale

name: Tamarind Chili Salt Cooler
steps: Rim with lime and chili salt
Stir tamarind, lime and agave
Add ice and top with sparkling water

name: Golden Turmeric Elixir
steps: Shake turmeric, ginger, lemon, honey, pepper and coconut water with ice
Double strain over fresh ice

name: Pineapple Jalapeño Smash
steps: Gently muddle jalapeño with lime and agave
Shake with pineapple and ice
Strain and float soda

name: Smoked Orange & Cardamom Fizz
steps: Char orange halves and juice them
Shake with cardamom syrup and lemon
Strain and top with tonic

name: Cranberry Rosemary Shrub
steps: Pour cranberry shrub and orange juice into the glass
Fill with ice and top with soda
Stir with rosemary

name: Blood Orange Ginger Elixir
steps: Shake blood orange, ginger syrup and lime with ice
Strain over a large cube; top with soda

name: Kadha (Immunity Brew)
steps: Simmer water with tulsi, ginger, pepper, cloves and cinnamon until reduced
Sweeten with jaggery and strain

name: Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh)
steps: Simmer milk with turmeric, ginger and pepper
Strain, cool slightly, stir in honey

name: Homemade Electrolyte Drink
steps: Stir lemon, honey and a pinch of salt into water and coconut water
Chill

name: Easy Mulled Apple Cider
steps: Simmer cider with cinnamon, cloves, orange and ginger for 15 minutes
Ladle into mugs

name: Apple Cider Vinegar Morning Tonic
steps: Stir everything into cool water

name: On The Mend Hot Toddy (Zero-Proof)
steps: Steep tea with cinnamon and clove
Stir in honey and lemon

name: Caramelized Apple Crisp Mocktail
steps: Shake cider, cinnamon caramel, lemon and oat milk with ice
Double strain into a chilled coupe
Dust with nutmeg

name: Virgin Black Forest Cherry Fizz
steps: Mix chocolate and cherry at the base
Add ice and soda
Crown with whipped cream and a cherry

name: Orange Blossom Honey Spritz
steps: Stir orange blossom water, orange-honey and lemon in a flute
Top slowly with sparkling grape

name: Cranberry Cinnamon Spice Toddy (Chilled)
steps: Stir cranberry, cinnamon syrup and orange with ice
Top with ginger ale

name: Billionaire's Hot Chocolate
steps: Whisk chocolate and caramel into hot milk
Top with cream and crushed shortbread

name: Classic Hot Chocolate
steps: Whisk cocoa and sugar into a paste with a splash of milk
Add the rest of the milk and heat until steaming

name: Eggless Eggnog
steps: Whisk milk, cream, condensed milk, spices and vanilla
Chill and grate nutmeg on top

name: Butterbeer (Fan Style)
steps: Stir butterscotch into cream soda
Float whipped butterscotch cream on top

name: Rum-Free Horchata Latte
steps: Blend soaked rice with cinnamon and water; strain
Sweeten, add milk and espresso over ice

name: Coconut Blackberry Smash
steps: Muddle blackberries
Add coconut, lime, syrup and ice; stir
Top with soda

name: Cookies & Cream Shake
steps: Blend ice cream, milk and crushed cookies until thick
